changelogs.1.0.3:
**Fixed:**
- Discord Rich Presence and custom audio upload dropdowns could appear outside the app or stay open after closing their dialog

**Added:**
- Resume paused clips using audio effects by pressing the effect hotkey and the play clip hotkey at the same time
- Logging for pausing and resuming clips

**Changed:**
- Discord Rich Presence settings now prompt to enable or customize instead of requiring manual setup
- Renamed "Play Clip" hotkey to "Play/Pause/Resume Clip" and refreshed the slot targeting hint with a clearer visual example
- Increased font size on utility buttons (audio method, test mic, upload, reset, hotkeys, favorites) for easier readability
- Redesigned the Console tab with color coded log entries and a clearer layout
